channel.title: FMallSectionsDR
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Two Jurors, Two Outcomes
item.description: Both 12 Angry Men and the Lindsay Clancy case featured a single holdout juror, but only one merits respect.

item.title: Cultivating Our Imaginations as We Age
item.description: Imagination remains essential with age, and it needs richer material to engage with.

item.title: The Underfunding Myth Exposed
item.description: Nikole Hannah-Jones and the NYT inadvertently acknowledge that funding is not the issue in public schools.

item.title: Mike McCaul, Public Servant
item.description: The Texas congressman departs the House properly, having acted rightly for the right reasons.
